observations.description: Original 3D cartoon animation in the same character style: a Wild-West gold mine, a top-hatted swindler, miners and investors.
Macro close-ups on the key detail (gold nugget in gravel, gold pan) alternate with medium character shots.
Text appears inside the scene (mine entrance sign 'SURE THING MINE'), no overlay graphics.
Warm amber lantern lighting throughout; a dust cloud fills the frame at the climax.
Captions show 1-2 words at a time in sentence case with punctuation kept; white heavy rounded sans-serif with a thin dark outline and soft shadow, centred just below the middle of the frame.
Explains a historical scam step by step and ends on the reveal of how the trick worked.
Hook is a single concrete paradox stated immediately: "He loaded the shotgun with gold and fired it into the walls of the mine."
Ends on a concrete payoff that resolves the hook, no call to action: "And when the dust clears, there's a vein of real gold as thick as your arm, 10 feet past where the last guy gave up."

categorical.hook_style: one-sentence concrete paradox (strange action, absurd consequence, or rule + contradiction), no intro
categorical.ending_style: concrete payoff image that resolves the hook, then the video stops (no CTA, no summary)
